claims.text: Committees: Natural Resources; Science, Space, and Technology.
Subcommittees: Energy and Mineral Resources; Water, Wildlife and Fisheries; Research and Technology; Investigations and Oversight.
Background: electrical engineer; founded DIY Girls; six years in the State Assembly.
Freshman Representative to Leadership, House Democrats, 119th Congress.

Caucuses: co-chair of the Congressional STEM Education Caucus; member of the Hispanic, Progressive, Democratic Women's, Labor, Asian Pacific American, Artificial Intelligence, Armenian Issues, Equality and Real Estate caucuses, SEEC, the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force and the U.S.-Mexico Caucus.
Washington office: 1319 Longworth House Office Building, (202) 225-6131. Arleta district office: 9300 Laurel Canyon Blvd, First Floor, (818) 253-3535.
Prop 50 redrew CA-29 for the 2026 election; the 2027 district has 760,066 residents (2020 Census): 735,380 in the City of Los Angeles, 24,055 in San Fernando and 627 unincorporated.
Won the Nov 3, 2026 general election over fellow Democrat Angélica María Dueñas, 57.3% to 42.7% (unofficial).
The California Democratic Party endorsed her (“CA 29 - Luz Rivas”) for the June 2026 primary.
